subject: Panel 1: dietary information and slides
body:
Hi Daniel,

Could you send any allergies or dietary restrictions (or confirm none), and share your 6–8 slides? The original deadlines were April 13 at 11:59 PM and April 15 at 6:00 PM respectively; please send them as soon as you can. A download link is fine. We’ve noted your projector and clicker request and your breakfast decline.

Please check in Friday, April 16 at 3:40 PM at Larkin Auditorium (14 Hollis Lane, Cambridge) for the 4:10–5:10 PM panel. The dinner is for speakers under the current policy; your guest request is pending organizer review and your wife is not confirmed.

Thanks,
Antara Conference Team
policy_refs: Networking dinner: Friday April 16, 7:00–9:00 PM. Speakers only (guests/companions are not covered by this policy). / Cena de networking: solo speakers (los acompañantes no están contemplados en esta política).

Slides: send by **Thursday April 15, 6:00 PM**. Large files can be sent as a download link. / Enviar las diapositivas hasta el **jueves 15 de abril, 6:00 PM**. Archivos pesados pueden enviarse como enlace.
send_blocked_reasons: Speaker has an open human decision.
